summary: casecheck's self-test lines of a profile's disks and overlays, each fault in a private copy of cases.c or of the case schema found by its own line

argv: ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O1 -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/include -I utils tools/etude/casecheck.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/cases.c tools/etude/digest.c tools/etude/judge.c tools/etude/json.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/schema.c tools/etude/verdict.c tools/etude/history.c tools/etude/history_json.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/casecheck && mkdir -p ${WORK}/schemas && cp tools/etude/schemas/*.json ${WORK}/schemas/ && cp ${SRC}/tools/etude/schemas/case.schema.json ${WORK}/schemas/case.schema.json

d=$TMPDIR/selftest && mkdir -p $d/fixtures && cp tools/etude/fixtures/disks.json tools/etude/fixtures/disks-bad.json tools/etude/fixtures/disks-shape.json tools/etude/fixtures/rules.json $d/fixtures/ && grep -F -e ' ./disks' -e '| overlay-guest:' tools/etude/fixtures/expect > $d/fixtures/expect && ln -s ${WORK}/schemas $d/schemas && ${WORK}/casecheck --selftest $d/fixtures; s=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $s

faults.name: twice
faults.summary: a disk given twice in a profile is not reported

| nine: the launcher attaches at most 8 disks of a profile
| ahci-seven: the launcher attaches at most 8 disks of a profile
| boot-two: the launcher attaches at most 8 disks of a profile
